name: Stage 46: Oppeby to Vittenberga
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 46, Oppeby to Vittenberga.
utilities: Söra scout area provides midpoint parking/access; Oppeby has nearby food and bus access; Vittenberga has bus/parking context via stage 47.

No official stage-46 toilet was verified. Naturkartan marks Söra-Hovrasjön as near toilet but did not expose an exact toilet pin; Nyköping C toilets are useful for train access but are more than 2 km from parts of this stage.
Oppeby torg has the cleanest food/resupply cluster for the start: ICA Knuten plus nearby pizzeria/cafe/sandwich options. Opening hours and exact businesses should be checked live.

Söra bus stop can be useful around the midpoint, and Vittenberga bus access appears to follow the sparse 667 Runtuna-Lid-Nyköping corridor. Use Sörmlandstrafiken live planning rather than hardcoded departures.
waterSources: Bergsstugan tap is the best verified refill and is listed as year-round in official material.

Hovrasjön/lake water is not quality-tested; Sörmlandsleden general guidance says lake water should be treated/boiled and cannot be guaranteed. A Komoot note reported Hovrasjön water as murky/filter-clogging, so prefer Bergsstugan.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Official distance is 8 km; Naturkartan measures about 7.7 km/7,685 m. Official/Naturkartan grade it easy/green; AllTrails' moderate label appears driven by calculated ascent/rooty sections.

Topology is clean: Naturkartan/official geometry and OSM relation 8426302 snap within a few metres at both ends. Use the Oppeby/Släbro hub around 58.770404,16.974075 for stages 45/46/46:1 and the Vittenberga hub around 58.808545,17.016173 for stages 46/47; keep 46:1 as a visible access branch rather than part of stage 46.

Official Sörmlandsleden page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass, and no current Nyköping municipal drift notice was found for Hovrasjön, Söra, Vittenberga, or the stage. Recent AllTrails reports in 2024-2025 also described good conditions.

Route character: starts at the foot/cycle bridge over Nyköpingsån, passes Trumpetarberget views, Hovrasjön shore, a floating/pontoon bridge toward Söra, and mixed road/forest walking to Vittenberga. Expect mostly firm easy paths, with isolated muddy/rooty sections after rain, especially north of Hagalund.

Good tenting is officially noted about 100 m south of Hovrasjön shelter. No intersecting nature reserve, Natura 2000, or Ramsar restriction was found for the Oppeby-Hovrasjön-Söra-Vittenberga corridor during the 2026-04-27 check, but allemansrätten, posted local rules, and leave-no-trace practice still apply.

The route passes local recreation/scout/preschool/horse-use areas around Hovrasjön, Söra and Berga. Expect mixed users, occasional horse context, and possible hunting activity in autumn; keep dogs under strict control and wear visible colors in hunting season.

Fire status is time-sensitive. Nyköping/Sörmlandskustens räddningstjänst showed no current fire ban during the research pass, but users must check live fire-ban and fire-risk status before using any fireplace. Ordinary bans and stricter bans differ, and Sörmlandsleden does not supply firewood at shelters.
Fishing is not covered by allemansrätten. Treat Nyköpingsån, Hovrasjön, and other freshwater along the stage as permit/check-before-fishing areas.

facilities.name: Oppeby stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start by the foot/cycle bridge over Nyköpingsån north of the school area. Oppeby torg bus and food are nearby.

facilities.name: Oppeby torg bus access
facilities.description: Closest practical bus access for the Oppeby start, about 350-400 m away; verify Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: ICA Knuten / Oppeby resupply
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply near the start, about 0.8 km from the route. Official stage page lists ICA Knuten as nearby food/fika.

facilities.name: Oppeby torg food context
facilities.description: Nearby start-area food/cafe context such as pizzeria, cafe and sandwich options. Commercial services; verify current businesses and opening hours.

facilities.name: Släbro runestones and carvings
facilities.description: Worthwhile short detour via connector 46:1: runestones, grave-field/old crossing context, and Bronze Age rock carvings beside Nyköpingsån.

facilities.name: Oppeby / Släbro shared route hub
facilities.description: Canonical snap hub for stages 45, 46, and 46:1. OSM node 4354585315 is within a few metres; merge these endpoints in the route builder.

facilities.name: Hovrasjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 4 km. Vindskyddskartan corroborates shelter, about 4 sleeping places, swimming, fireplace, and unknown-quality water.

facilities.name: Hovrasjön shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace reported at the Hovrasjön shelter. Use only if current fire-ban and local fire-risk status allow; Sörmlandsleden does not supply firewood at shelters.

facilities.name: Hovrasjön lake/rest
facilities.description: Lake/rest context at Hovrasjön shelter. Not verified as an official municipal badplats, and lake water is not a drinking-water refill; treat/boil if used.

facilities.name: Hovrasjön tent area
facilities.description: Official text says good tenting about 100 m south of the Hovrasjön shelter; approximate inferred pin.

facilities.name: Hovrasjön floating bridge
facilities.description: Floating/pontoon bridge route feature toward Söra. Local reports say it replaced a muddier awkward section and improved passage.

facilities.name: Söra motionsslingan shelter
facilities.description: Official second shelter after about 5 km near Söra motionsslingan. Facility detail is sparse; verify on site.

facilities.name: Berga/Söra shelter context
facilities.description: Nearby shelter-map/OSM marker in the Söra area. Vindskyddskartan reports fireplace, possible firewood checked 2024-05-06, swimming, water of unknown quality, and no confirmed toilet; may not be identical to the official Söra coordinate.

facilities.name: Söra parking
facilities.description: Mapped parking near Söra/Hovrasjön; official text also says parking exists at Söra scout hut and just after turning off the asphalt road.

facilities.name: Use signed Söra parking only
facilities.description: Use signed parking by/near Söra scout hut and do not park cars or campervans in forest, grass, fields, or other terrain; allemansrätten does not cover motor vehicles.

facilities.name: Söra scoutgård
facilities.description: Rentable scout hut with simple hostel-style beds/kitchen by arrangement; not a public trail shelter. Also an access/parking context.

facilities.name: Söra shared-use area
facilities.description: Scout, preschool, horse and local recreation context around Söra/Hovrasjön. Keep dogs close, avoid activity areas, and give horses/livestock extra space.

facilities.name: Bergsstugan tap
facilities.description: Official year-round tap/water point at B&B Bergsstugan after about 6.5 km. Best verified refill on stage 46; still carry backup.

facilities.name: Bergsstugan B&B
facilities.description: Official lodging context at/near the year-round tap. Accommodation and indoor services require booking/host access.

facilities.name: Hovra bus access
facilities.description: Mid-stage bus access near Bergsstugan/Hovra; route references point to line 667 corridor. Verify current Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Källsättersvägen bus access
facilities.description: Additional rural line-667 corridor stop between Hovra and Vittenberga. Service can be sparse; verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Ekebystugan bus access
facilities.description: Rural bus stop shortly before Vittenberga. Useful bailout/access context, but expect limited shelter and sparse service.

facilities.name: Söra bus access
facilities.description: Bus access near Söra, roughly 100-200 m from the route/shelter area. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Vittenberga stage end
facilities.description: Official stage 46 end/stage 47 start at the road toward Lid/Runtuna. Stage 47 confirms Vittenberga bus stop and possible parking east of the road at the forest-road entrance.

facilities.name: Vittenberga bus stop
facilities.description: Closest researched bus stop near the endpoint, about 120 m away; route references point to line 667. Verify timetable live.

facilities.name: Vittenberga parking context
facilities.description: Possible parking on the east side of the road at the forest-road entrance per official stage 47 text; verify signs.

facilities.name: Vittenberga shared route hub
facilities.description: Canonical snap hub for stages 46 and 47. Naturkartan and OSM endpoints are within a few metres here; merge these endpoints in the route builder.

facilities.name: Stage 46 fire-risk check
facilities.description: No current fire ban was found during the 2026-04-27 pass, but fire bans/fire risk are dynamic. Check Nyköping/Sörmlandskustens and national fire-ban map before using fireplaces.

facilities.name: No protected-area restriction found
facilities.description: Skyddad natur checks found no intersecting nature reserve, Natura 2000, or Ramsar restriction in the Stage 46 corridor during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Follow posted signs and normal allemansrätten.

facilities.name: Dog control on Stage 46
facilities.description: From 1 March to 20 August dogs must be under strict control where wildlife may be present; leash is the practical default. Keep dogs close year-round around scouts, children, horses and livestock.

facilities.name: Freshwater fishing requires permission
facilities.description: Fishing is not included in allemansrätten. Verify fishing card/permission for Nyköpingsån, Hovrasjön, and other freshwater along the stage before fishing.

facilities.name: Oppeby school-area works watch
facilities.description: Municipal school/sports-field works nearby are planned around 2026-2027, but no Stage 46 access closure was found. Watch local signs around the Oppeby start.
